extension.description: Installs the private KingBlap Kodi build using an access code, restores saved add-on profile data, enables packaged add-ons, sets and refreshes Gismeteo for Thomasville, North Carolina, removes the OnePlay repository, and applies Xonfluence 6.0.7 after installation and on Kodi startup.
extension.disclaimer: The private build may include service credentials saved in add-on profile data. Only people with the shared access code can download it; share the code and build only with intended recipients. The Wizard's own settings and access code are excluded from restored profile data.
